candidate_changes: Only metal/unary.metal and metal/dsv4_misc.metal, loaded with source overrides.
overlap_credit: Emilian Bold, f3e16a19d37f9c17d2f42869474742e9993c7098; adapted privately to the current scorer.
model_integrity: File size, inode and mtime unchanged within each host suite; no full GGUF hash was computed.
overlap_definition: Sum min(API probability, local probability) over unique mapped API alternatives; no renormalization.
overlap_bounds: Lower bound is the known sum; upper bound adds min(unmapped API mass, unmapped local mass).
validation: Complete paired manifests and counts; independent per-position trace reconstruction of NLL, overlap and captured mass.
caveats: Curated prompt set, not a random task benchmark. Long prompts reuse three task families; long-set intervals are descriptive, not independent-task confidence.
Temperature-1 API samples, not greedy references or full vocabulary logits.
Case 047 has 65 local tokens versus 64 API/published-tokenizer tokens; text NLL retained, API comparisons omitted.
No equivalence margin was prespecified; intervals including zero are not proof of equivalence.
V4.1 references cannot establish quality for the older Flash or Vision-Exp checkpoints.
